5801: internal_rename(path_t *src, path_t *dst, int src_dir_fd, int dst_dir_fd, int is_replace)
5802: {
5803:     const char *function_name = is_replace ? "replace" : "rename";
5804:     int dir_fd_specified;
5805: 
5806: #ifdef HAVE_RENAMEAT
5807:     int renameat_unavailable = 0;
5808: #endif
5809: 
5810: #ifdef MS_WINDOWS
5811:     BOOL result;
5812:     int flags = is_replace ? MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING : 0;
5813: #else
5814:     int result;
5815: #endif
5816: 
5817:     dir_fd_specified = (src_dir_fd != DEFAULT_DIR_FD) ||
5818:                        (dst_dir_fd != DEFAULT_DIR_FD);
5819: #ifndef HAVE_RENAMEAT
5820:     if (dir_fd_specified) {
5821:         argument_unavailable_error(function_name, "src_dir_fd and dst_dir_fd");
5822:         return NULL;
5823:     }
5824: #endif
5825: 
5826:     if (PySys_Audit("os.rename", "OOii", src->object, dst->object,
5827:                     src_dir_fd == DEFAULT_DIR_FD ? -1 : src_dir_fd,
5828:                     dst_dir_fd == DEFAULT_DIR_FD ? -1 : dst_dir_fd) < 0) {
5829:         return NULL;
5830:     }
5831: 
5832: #ifdef MS_WINDOWS
5833:     Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS
5834:     result = MoveFileExW(src->wide, dst->wide, flags);
5835:     Py_END_ALLOW_THREADS
5836: 
5837:     if (!result)
5838:         return path_error2(src, dst);
5839: 
5840: #else
5841:     if ((src->narrow && dst->wide) || (src->wide && dst->narrow)) {
5842:         PyErr_Format(PyExc_ValueError,
5843:                      "%s: src and dst must be the same type", function_name);
5844:         return NULL;
5845:     }
5846: 
5847:     Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS
5848: #ifdef HAVE_RENAMEAT
5849:     if (dir_fd_specified) {
5850:         if (HAVE_RENAMEAT_RUNTIME) {
5851:             result = renameat(src_dir_fd, src->narrow, dst_dir_fd, dst->narrow);
5852:         } else {
5853:             renameat_unavailable = 1;
5854:         }
5855:     } else
5856: #endif
5857:     result = rename(src->narrow, dst->narrow);
5858:     Py_END_ALLOW_THREADS
5859: 
5860: 
5861: #ifdef HAVE_RENAMEAT
5862:     if (renameat_unavailable) {
5863:         argument_unavailable_error(function_name, "src_dir_fd and dst_dir_fd");
5864:         return NULL;
5865:     }
5866: #endif
5867: 
5868:     if (result)
5869:         return path_error2(src, dst);
5870: #endif
5871:     Py_RETURN_NONE;
5872: }
